propositions: The divergent_implementation axis is mis-calibrated (fires on 7.72% of plan-v3 findings) and must be converted from ordinal grades (none/low/medium/high) to a closed Literal set encoding divergence kind: contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration, none.

The new grade set requires structural changes to impact_plan: exclude divergent_implementation from _SEV01 loop, add DIVERGENCE_GRADE01 map with incomplete_enumeration contributing below 0.60 floor and the two floor grades flooring at 0.85.

A high-cost LLM-based calibration methodology (purpose-built eval suites, bulk re-review) must be rejected in favor of zero-marginal-cost forms: corpus replay of existing REVIEW_RESULT sidecars and dogfooding observation, per ADR-0054.

The prod_impact floor (Fix 2) is rejected because it escapes the novelty_priority_floor convergence reservoir (~1.9x worse than Fix 1) and creates non-terminating remediation loops where findings recur at high priority regardless of plan author action.

Every fixture, prompt, and consumer of the divergent_implementation axis must migrate from ordinal values to the new Literal; ordinal-graded fixtures in tests/interfaces (outside unit suite) are unenumerated sites the change provably must touch.

The impact_model_version must bump to plan-v4; legacy plan-v3 sidecars must remain readable; enrich_operator_attested must unconditionally set incomplete_enumeration to none on attestation while floor grades survive unchanged.
